start_position: Hinge forward, back flat, knees soft
Arms hang straight under the shoulders, palms in
concentric: Pull the elbows up and back
Keep the elbows close to the body
eccentric: Lower slowly until the arms are straight

validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.
validation_profile.max_hand_into_bar_comment: The skin of the palm is rigid in this rig. Up to 8 mm of palm pad inside the bar stands for soft tissue pressed flat by the load; more than that, or any finger passing through the bar, is a defect.

technical_cues: Torso stays still; only the arms move
Elbows travel close to the ribs
common_mistakes: Standing up as you pull (using momentum)
muscle_roles_note: Three levels (Kiệt 15/11): primary = carries the load and produces the main force; secondary = directly assists the movement; stabilizing = holds posture and keeps joints stable. Shoulder extension (lats) and scapular retraction (middle/lower trapezius, rhomboids) move the load: ExRx target Back, General. Posterior deltoid, infraspinatus/teres minor, biceps and brachioradialis assist the pull. Erector spinae, hamstrings and gluteus maximus hold the hinge; the upper trapezius holds the shoulder girdle against the hanging weight.
